# FG-AIASSET-0008

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `bundle_signed_only_when_bench_green` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この tag から AI 資産のリリースを作れません。理由を確かめて、条件を満たした tag でもう一度作ってください。
- en: An AI asset release cannot be made from this tag. Check the reason and make it again from a tag that meets the conditions.
- id: Rilis aset AI tidak dapat dibuat dari tag ini. Periksa alasannya dan buat lagi dari tag yang memenuhi syarat.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 17 P17-7 §1.8 (ADR-0031 Amendment P17-7): a `pfs-ai-bundle` release is made only from a tag `assets/vYYYY.WW.N` of a project whose `ai_assets.enabled` is on, pinned to the commit the tag names when the release is made, on a protected branch, whose `forge/ai-eval` check (the release candidate's bench) concluded `success`, whose bundle files lint clean and fit the bounds. `reason`: `ai_assets_disabled`, `tag_invalid` (not `assets/v<yyyy>.<ww>.<n>`), `tag_not_found`, `tag_not_a_commit`, `already_released` (the version, or another tag at the same commit, was released before: a moved tag has no effect), `not_on_protected_branch`, `bench_missing` (no `forge/ai-eval` run on the commit), `bench_not_green` (with `conclusion`), `lint_failed` (with the first `rule` and `subject` of forge_doc::ai_asset::lint or release_problems), `not_a_regular_file` (a symlink or submodule in a bundle directory), `too_many_files`, `too_large`, `bundle_empty`, `manifest_invalid` (a manifest that does not parse or verify). Nothing was written or signed.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The route logs `forge.deploy.bundle_refused` with `error_code=FG-AIASSET-0008`, `request_id`, `project_id`, `version`, `reason` (and `conclusion` / `rule` / `subject`). Read: SELECT name, status, conclusion FROM forge.check_runs WHERE project_id = <id> AND head_sha = <sha> AND name = 'forge/ai-eval'; SELECT version, commit_sha, tag FROM forge.ai_bundle_releases WHERE project_id = <id> ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5; `gstn ai-asset lint` in a checkout of the tag.

## 対処 (fix)

Merge the change into the protected branch, wait for the bench (forge/ai-eval success) on that commit, fix the lint, and cut a new tag with the next version (a released version never changes; never move a released tag).
